title: TlsError::KeyLoad uses literal '<secretx>' placeholder, hides which URI failed
description: In crates/tls/src/lib.rs, load_private_key_from_bytes uses the string literal '<secretx>' as the path label in TlsError::KeyLoad. When TLS startup fails due to a malformed PEM from a secrets manager, the operator sees 'failed to load TLS key at <secretx>: ...' with no indication of which secretx URI caused the problem. The URI should be threaded through so the error says 'failed to load TLS key at secretx:aws-sm:prod/stoa/tls-private-key: ...'. Possible fix: add a separate constructor load_private_key_from_bytes_with_label(pem_bytes, label) or change the signature to take the URI as a label parameter.
